diagrams.prompt:
Create one separate, polished UML use-case diagram image for a GitHub README of the Russian-language project AI Instruction Design 2.0.0. This is a formal UML use-case diagram, not a flowchart. Landscape wide canvas approximately 1800 by 1150 pixels. Flat white background, no gradients, no shadows, no decorative graphics. Dark slate text, blue (#2563eb) use-case outlines, pale blue oval fills, charcoal stick-figure actor and solid association lines. Crisp professional typography with precise readable Cyrillic (Noto Sans / Arial), large enough at README width. Generous whitespace. Keep the complete image within margins.

Title at top, exact Russian: "Сценарии использования"
Subtitle: "AI Instruction Design · 2.0.0"

Outside the system rectangle on the left: exactly ONE standard UML stick figure labeled "Пользователь".
Inside a large clean system rectangle labeled "AI-агент со скиллом": exactly FIVE oval use cases.
Four primary ovals stacked vertically at x about 860, y about 310 / 485 / 660 / 835, each with a short precise label:
"Создать инструкцию"
"Адаптировать инструкцию"
"Исправить наблюдённый сбой"
"Провести аудит"
A fifth shared supporting oval at x about 1370 and y about 570: two lines "Определить режим" / "и область работы".
Connect actor with four plain solid undirected association lines to the FOUR primary use cases. Carefully fan them out from a shared point near the actor torso. Do not connect the actor directly to the fifth supporting case.
Connect EACH of the four primary use cases to the fifth with a dashed UML dependency arrow whose OPEN V-shaped arrowhead points at the fifth case. Each of these four arrows has exactly the label "«include»". These arrows mean mandatory shared behavior; they do not depict ordering. Leave labels unobstructed and not crossing the ovals. No other edges. If needed keep edges to different landing points on the supporting oval to make them legible.

Under the rectangle, a neat concise note with exact text on two lines:
"Аудит: замечания без изменения файлов."
"Правка: только в пределах действующей авторизации."
Small footer legend exact: "Сплошная линия — участие актора · «include» — обязательный общий сценарий"

Make every label verbatim and correctly spelled. All use cases must be ellipses, actor outside the system boundary, no arrowheads on actor associations, no decision diamonds, no activity boxes. The design must be clean and carefully aligned, with no extraneous English besides the UML stereotype include and project name.

Create one separate, polished UML use-case diagram image for a GitHub README of the Russian-language project AI Instruction Design 2.0.0. Same visual system as a clean professional engineering diagram: landscape wide canvas approximately 1900 by 1250 pixels, flat white, dark slate text, blue (#2563eb) thin oval outlines and pale blue oval fills, charcoal UML stick figures, rectangular system boundary. One optional oval may use a subtle pale violet fill and purple outline. Large crisp readable Cyrillic typography (Noto Sans / Arial), generous whitespace, no gradients, no shadows, no flowchart shapes or decorative illustrations.

Title exact at top: "Проверка и развитие скилла"
Subtitle exact: "AI Instruction Design · 2.0.0"

Two standard UML stick figure actors OUTSIDE the boundary: on the left "Разработчик скилла", on the right "Независимый оценщик". Labels can wrap into two lines without changing their words.
Large system rectangle labeled "Протокол проверки качества".
Exactly SIX oval use cases inside, arranged for readability:
1 upper-left: "Проверить структуру пакета"
2 middle-left: "Подготовить регрессионные случаи"
3 lower-left: three lines "Сравнить базу," / "текущую версию" / "и кандидата"
4 upper-right / middle-right: "Зафиксировать конфигурацию"
5 lower-right: "Оценить ответы вслепую"
6 bottom-center: "Проверить правило абляцией" (subtle violet optional use case).

Plain solid undirected associations from the developer actor to cases 1, 2, 3. A plain solid undirected association from independent evaluator actor to case 5. No arrowheads on these associations.
Exactly THREE dashed UML dependency arrows:
case 3 -> case 4 with OPEN V-shaped arrowhead at case 4, label "«include»";
case 3 -> case 5 with OPEN V-shaped arrowhead at case 5, label "«include»";
case 6 -> case 3 with OPEN V-shaped arrowhead at case 3, label "«extend»".
Keep all edges and labels legible without crossing ovals; spread positions as necessary. Include means mandatory included behavior; extend means optional behavior from extension to base, never reversed. Do not draw any other dependency arrows or execution sequence.

Three small notes below the system, aligned and separated, exact Russian:
"Структурный PASS подтверждает целостность пакета."
"Условия раскрывают после фиксации оценок."
"Критические нарушения не скрывают средней оценкой."
Small footnote for the optional extension:
"Абляция: отдельное правило добавлено, усилено или стало дорого стоить."

Every listed phrase must be verbatim, no extra labels, no duplicate nodes, no decorative charts, no activity flow. Large clean formal ellipses inside the rectangle, actors outside. Clear high-quality UML diagram image suitable for a README.
